name: Teensy 4.0
description: 600 MHz Cortex-M7 (i.MX RT1062) in a 36x18 mm breadboard module with 2 MB flash, 1 MB RAM, USB 2.0 device+host pads, 3 CAN and 7 UARTs.
notes: Only 24 of the 40 I/O pins are on the breadboard headers (D0-D23); D24-D39, USB host D+/D-, VBAT, On/Off and Program are small underside pads. Headers are not pre-soldered.
3.3 V I/O only (not 5 V tolerant); 3.3 V regulator limited to 250 mA; USB micro-B.
Programmed with Teensyduino and a HalfKay bootloader (press the button); CAN and USB host need external transceivers/connectors.
No Ethernet PHY or SD socket - see Teensy 4.1.
